business_summary: Guangdong SQ New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of functional materials for electronic and electrical products in China and internationally. It offers thermal control solutions, including synthetic graphite rolls, graphite heat dissipation sheet, mica belt, silicone frame, flame retardant silicone skin, two component thermally conductive structural adhesive, ultra-thin vc, ultra-thin heat pipe, thermal grease, thermally conductive phase change materials, thermally conductive potting compound, synthetic graphite thermal interface material, multifunctional composite heat sink, thermal conductive gel, thermal conductivity anistropic silicone, thermally conductive silicone pads, and heat dissipation pads; electromagnetic shielding solutions, such as magnetic absorbing materials, nanocrystalline magnetic materials, and amorphous magnetic shielding sheet; protection solutions, such as nano waterproof protective coating. It serves consumer electronics, new energy vehicle, communication equipment, industrial control, and semiconductor industry. Guangdong SQ New Material Co., Ltd. was formerly known as GuangDong Suqun New Material Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong SQ New Material Co., Ltd. in September 2026. Guangdong SQ New Material Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
